title: Keto Chickpea Flatbread Bites
description: A keto twist on traditional flatbread, made with chickpea flour and crunchy texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chickpea flour, almond flour, and salt.
Add eggs and mix until a dough forms.
Add crunchy almonds and mix until well combined.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
While baking, slice juicy tomato into thin slices.
Once flatbreads are done, let cool for 5 minutes.
Top each flatbread with a slice of tomato.
